text:
hedy: Small creative ask for next-week launch microsite. Need by Tue noon PT: 1) benchmark hero (1400x700) with a compact explainer panel, 2) an illustrated mini-diagram (800x400) that visualizes 'serving path' (request -> KV cache -> GPU pool -> response), 3) gated webinar modal (480x320) that wires hidden lead-routing fields, 4) social vertical (1080x1350) GIF. Keep everything brand-safe and accessible. cc @omar @jess

omar: Sounds good. Can you share the primary copy + an alt? Also specify the diagram style (flat icons vs schematic).

hedy: Primary headline: "Serve LLMs with steady latency and predictable unit cost." Alt headline: "Ship AI features faster with stable performance." Diagram: schematic (simple boxes + arrows), not literal chips. Figma: https://figma.com/file/microsite-bench-4819

jess: For the mini-diagram, do we need labels on each box? e.g., "prefix cache" "batch router" "GPU pool"?

hedy: Yes short labels only. Add a tiny caption: "Abstract serving flow; representative only." No specific hardware names.

kevin: Webinar modal CTA copy: "Save my seat Seats limited". Modal should attach hidden fields: utm_campaign, utm_source, utm_variant, webinar_id, and an internal lead_tag. Example webinar_id=2026-07-07. Also want a version where CTA includes utm_variant=headlineA or headlineB so analytics can split.

figmabot: Frame created: microsite_hero_v1 (1400x700), serving_diagram_v1 (800x400), webinar_modal_v1 (480x320), social_gif_v1 (1080x1350). Link: https://figma.com/frame/microsite-frames-4819

omar: I'll mock hero + diagram by Friday EOD. GIF concept Monday AM (subtle sparkline + pulse on CTA). Keep GIF <2MB if possible.

jess: For diagram accessibility: include a short text alternative that reads the boxes in sequence. I'll add alt copy to the drive.

kevin: UTMs to use (copy/paste):
```
utm_campaign=microsite_launch_jul2026
utm_source=social
utm_variant=headlineB
```
We'll swap variant for headlineA / headlineB per test.

hedy: Brand tokens: CTA #FF3B30, type Inter, CTA weight 600. Please include high-contrast export. Motion token = short spring. Use brand illustration color palette (teal accent allowed).

legalbot: Reminder: no absolute percentage claims or hardware names. Use verbs like "lower" or "reduced" not "X% faster" unless you have the vetted figure. I'll review copy Monday.

jess: Quick question on localization: JP yes, DE no. JP headline may need extra vertical room.

omar: Noted. I'll make headline container scalable and provide a JP frame. Also will keep headline as separate text layer for easy swaps.

hedy: Export checklist for final handoff: hero png @2x (1400x700), diagram svg + png, modal html-ready png + csv of hidden fields, social mp4 + gif fallback, alt-text file, and a tiny csv with the full utm strings for engineers.

figmabot: Added export checklist to figma file and created comment thread for analytics wiring: https://figma.com/comments/microsite-4819

kevin: Analytics note: please ensure the modal CTA uses the exact param ordering our tracking expects (utm_*, then webinar_id, then lead_tag). I'll share the snippet in comments.

jess: I'll attach alt-text drafts and the motion description for the GIF. Tag me when hero mock is uploaded so I can validate contrast.

hedy: Timeline recap: hero + diagram drafts Fri EOD, GIF rough Mon AM, copy/legal review Mon, JP translation Tue morning, final handoff Tue 12pm PT. Thanks all.

omar: :thumbsup: Will ping when frames are ready.

kevin: Added myself to figma comments for UTM/analytics checks.

hedy: Closing loop please avoid chip/vendor names and absolute metrics.
